prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline, and whether you need full-service brand strategy, creative, digital/paid media, SEO, PR, or B2B demand generation.

To help you find the best fit, tell me:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, PR, etc.)
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, retail, tech, nonprofit, etc.)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget
- Preferred engagement size (big agency vs. small boutique/local)
- Timeline (ongoing vs. campaign/project)

Quick guidance and next steps
- Big/full-service options in KC: VML (global digital/creative) and Barkley (independent creative/brand) are two well-known firms headquartered in Kansas City — good if you want broad capabilities and deep creative/strategy teams.
- If you need performance marketing, SEO, or social ads and have a smaller budget, a boutique or specialist agency may give more focused ROI.
- How to evaluate agencies: review case studies and measurable results, ask for references from similar clients, check team experience, request a pilot project or short trial, and clarify reporting/KPIs and contract terms.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a tailored shortlist of Kansas City agencies (I’ll need the details above), or
- Provide a short RFP template and interview questions to use when contacting agencies.

Which would you prefer?
